parts:
Hi I'm beginner and i have the following in ui.R

library(shiny)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  headerPanel("CARTAS DE CONTROL"),
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("dataset", "Servicio",

    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.dataset == 'tel'",
      selectInput("datasetTel", "Selecione el tipo", 
                  list("Voz Tradicional"="to", "Voz IP"="toip")))
    
  ),
  mainPanel(
    h3(textOutput("caption")),

how i can to modify or change the parameters of my ui.R, i.e, how i can insert picture, images, how i can choose the position of th graphic (up, centre, down ), how i can change the background color.


thanks for your time.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: change parameters of ui.R
parts:
You can use HTML in Shiny apps in several ways.

1) Inside of sidebarPanel and mainPanel, you can insert arbitrary HTML expressions using R code. See the ?tags help topic for details and examples. Here is an example reflecting <p><img src="foo"/> bar</p>

p(img(src="foo"), "bar")

If you need a tag whose name is not explicitly exported, you can use the tags object which contains all valid HTML tags (that we know about today). For example the previous example could equally have been written as:

tags$p(tags$img(src="foo"), "bar")

2) Inside of sidebarPanel and mainPanel, you can also include literal HTML strings by using the HTML function, for example:

HTML('<p><img src="foo"/> bar</p>')

3) You can put HTML in a separate file, and from sidebarPanel or mainPanel you can use the includeHTML function. The HTML file should be in the same directory as ui.R or in a subdirectory that is not named www.

4) If you still want to go the index.html route, the way to do that is to create a www directory in your app directory, and put index.html in that.

|-- server.R
|-- www
   |-- index.html
